channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ed Stefanski | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ed Stefanski from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Gores on Ed Stefanski
item.description:
Gores on Ed Stefanski:

“Ed is worried about making us one of the most dynamic front offices in the entire league. ... Ed can do anything, and he's willing to.”

Tom Gores on Ed Stefanski, Jun 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Ed Stefanski, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“I had a couple of great meetings, one with the management, with Ed Stefanski, who's a great GM, a great guy, he's a main reason why the job is appealing, along with (Blake Griffin) and also Andre Drummond and Reggie Jackson,”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Ed Stefanski, Reggie Jackson, Andre Drummond, Jun 10, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Ed Stefanski
item.description:
Bryan Colangelo on the Woj report Stefanski talks hit a snag at some point:

“It was errant, there was never an offer made, there was never a snag, we were going along at our timeline and obviously that timeline was not agreeable with someone on the outside.”

Bryan Colangelo on Ed Stefanski, Oct 27, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Ed Stefanski
item.description:
“Ed Stefanski embodies everything I was hoping to attain when the search began for a top level basketball executive to join our staff,”

Bryan Colangelo on Ed Stefanski, Oct 26, 2011. Source: NBA.com.
